post.description: Terminal refund event sent to the original sale callbackUrl, falling back to the merchant default webhook URL. Verify HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw body before parsing, using the merchant webhook secret (ADR-010). Reject signature timestamps beyond 300 seconds; compare in constant time. Deliveries are at least once and can arrive out of order. Deduplicate by the signed body id. Secret rotation takes effect immediately (no dual signing); failed deliveries retry for approximately 31 hours. API keys are not sent with webhooks. The refund and transaction snapshot stays byte-identical across retries/redrives; retain the maximum cumulative refundedAmount using decimal arithmetic.

Secret rotation takes effect immediately (no dual signing); failed deliveries retry for approximately 31 hours. API keys are not sent with webhooks.
